description: This file implements a command-line utility for encrypting and decrypting data using the PC1 cipher algorithm (Pukall Cipher 1). It includes functions for initializing, encrypting, decrypting, and processing data buffers, as well as command-line argument parsing and file I/O operations.

methods.name: pc1_finish
methods.description: Clears all variables in the PC1 cipher context to erase sensitive data.

methods.name: pc1_code
methods.description: Performs core encryption/decryption step on the PC1 cipher context.

methods.name: pc1_assemble
methods.description: Assembles the key schedule for the PC1 cipher based on the key and internal state.

methods.name: pc1_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a single byte using the PC1 cipher context.

methods.name: pc1_encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a single byte using the PC1 cipher context.

methods.name: pc1_init
methods.description: Initializes the PC1 cipher context with a predefined key.

methods.name: pc1_decrypt_buf
methods.description: Decrypts a buffer of data using the PC1 cipher context.

methods.name: pc1_encrypt_buf
methods.description: Encrypts a buffer of data using the PC1 cipher context.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line utility.
